MAT1001 Midterm Examination Information


Time: 9:30 to 11:30 AM, Saturday, October 28.

Location: See Blackboard.

Examination scope: Chapters 2, 3, and 4 of Thomas Calculus (13th Edi-
tion in SI Unit), except 2.3.

Policy:

   • No books, no notes, no dictionaries, and no calculators.

   • Unless speciﬁed otherwise, you are expected to show intermediate steps
      or reasoning that lead to your ﬁnal answer of a question.
